sources.title: Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-quantized.w8a8 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Optimizations This model was obtained by quantizing the weights of Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct to INT8 data type. This optimization reduces the number of bits used to represent weights and activations from 16 to 8, reducing GPU memory requirements (by approximately 50%) and increasing matrix-multiply compute throughput (by approximately 2x).

sources.title: RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-quantized.w8a8 - Socket
sources.snippet: This model is a quantized version of Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct. It was evaluated on a several tasks to assess the its quality in comparison to the unquatized model, including multiple-choice, math reasoning, and open-ended text generation.

sources.snippet: Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-quantized.w8a8是一个面向多语言环境的对话式文本生成服务，支持英语、德语、法语、意大利语、葡萄牙语、印地语、西班牙语和泰语等语言，适用于商业和研究场景中的智能助手类应用。该服务基于LlamaForCausalLM架构，采用INT8量化技术对模型权重和激活值进行优化，通过GPTQ算法 ...
